name: Emma Rockford
source:
Intelligent and driven, with a mind that outpaces her peers on her worst days, Emma Rockford is every lawyer’s worst nightmare even when she’s still half-asleep. Blessed with talent and a complete lack of awareness about it, she can humiliate the competition just by trying to be accommodating. Despite boasting an education and upbringing that could’ve landed her in any boardroom in the country, she works as a prosecutor for the city, to the befuddlement of her peers and frustration of her opponents. 
While she might not always care about her appearance, the moment she sets foot in the courtroom, there’s no margin of error.
